title: Moon microbes myth – can life really survive there?

scenes.text: NASA found that Bacillus spores can endure lunar surface conditions
Many believe no life can survive the Moon’s vacuum and radiation.
scenes.label: Life impossible on Moon

scenes.text: Studies show hardy bacterial spores remain viable after exposure to vacuum, extreme temperature swings, and UV.
scenes.label: Spore survival proven

scenes.text: Survival time recorded up to 30 days in lab simulations.
scenes.label: 30‑day survival

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: Debunk the myth that nothing can live on the Moon—real experiments prove some microbes survive. Follow for daily science!
